title: Physics and engineering
scope: Defined constants, CODATA values with their uncertainties, and the conditions NASA Glenn states on the working equations. A number marked exact in a table is not reported as a measurement, and a truncated listing is not completed from memory.
why_not_core: The core states a few laws and that the speed of light is exact. The digits, the uncertainties, and the assumptions on F = ma, Bernoulli, Mach, and Reynolds are the depth.

primary_sources.title: Beginner's Guide to Aeronautics, NASA Glenn
